relation_to_upstream: KUKA-specific extension of the RoboDojo hybrid-rollout flow. Adapts to the upstream interfaces (skill/schema.py, robodojo_server/gate_assessment.py, robodojo_server/kinematics.py, robodojo_server/client.py tool surface) rather than introducing a parallel application.

robot.tcp_transform: UNKNOWN -- custom $TOOL not identified; eef mode disabled

ported_from.note: logic re-implemented against upstream interfaces; no runtime import of that tree

differences_from_upstream_forced_by_embo: single 6-DoF arm, not a dual ARX-X5: left/right wrappers dropped
edit offsets are JOINT-SPACE degrees, not Cartesian metres/radians, because no verified TCP or IK exists
eef mode is REMOVED from the emitted schema until TCP and IK are verified
real command path is a Jetson RSI UDP/XML gateway, not a simulator RPC

execution_status.a800_role: pi0.5 proposal only; live Astra requires A800_LIVE_REVIEW=1 and a dedicated key
execution_status.jetson_role: sole KUKA command gateway; shadow mode logs what it would emit
